steps.title: Discovery & Alignment
steps.desc: We sit down (virtually) to understand your exact vision, timeline, and realistic budget. No fluff.

steps.title: Land Search & Verification
steps.desc: Our legal team verifies the title, checks for encumbrances, and ensures the land is 100% yours and safe to build on.

steps.title: Design & Approvals
steps.desc: We produce world-class architectural designs and handle the bureaucracy of local council approvals.

steps.title: Transparent Costing
steps.desc: You receive a realistic, un-inflated BOQ (Bill of Quantities). If any changes occur, you approve them first.

steps.title: Milestone Construction
steps.desc: We build. You watch via live cams and weekly timestamped reports. Payments are released only when milestones are hit.

steps.title: Handover & LimpioClean
steps.desc: The keys are handed over to a spotless, professionally deep-cleaned home ready for you to move in.
